in_marathi.name: Arbaj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arbaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Arvam' meaning mountain. 'Baj' means born. This name signifies being born on a mountainous terrain.

in_bengali.name: Arbaj
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Mountain born
in_bengali.long_meaning: Arbaj একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Arvam' meaning mountain. 'Baj' means born. This name signifies being born on a mountainous terrain.
